text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending a short-term parking zone in front of Buchanan Public School on both sides of the existing school bus loading zone. The proposed short term parking will operate during the weekday, daytime period and create approximately eight on-street short-term parking spaces at this location and will further facilitate student pick-up and drop-off activities fronting the school.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized parking for a maximum period of 10 minutes from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the north side of Bucannan Road, between a point 15 metres east of Tower Drive and a point 30 metres further east, and between a point 98 metres east of Tower Drive and a point 25 metres further east.
